Scheme A treats DS84 UWW1 as independent of DS01 although DF09 places UWW1 ~0.13 km from DS01 SAMEA4777503 (same Pagla STP area); the co-location-aware schemes B and D change the result (see independent_value), so the DF08 p = 0.048 is not robust to the unit definition.
